title: Pendulum, the experiment the agent asked for: damping confirmed
description: The same 0.5 m pendulum and release, filmed for 12.6 s instead of 6.5 (the same public video, which shows the swing for longer than the first analysis used). The question the agent asked is settled: the simple pendulum falls 121 BIC behind, and damping forecasts the held-out motion within 1.9% (without damping: 4.4%). A finer question remains: linear damping and air drag tie, and the agent designs the recording that would separate them (release from about 20 degrees, film 13 s). Both give g = 9.828 m/s² (95%: 9.824 to 9.831).
